The above financial results of the Company were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved and taken on record by the Board of Directors at the meeting held on May 19, 2022. During the year ended 31 March 2022, the company has raised additional capital of Rs.6517.60 lakhs by way of preferential allotment of equity shares. The company has issued 9655700 shares at a price of Rs.67.50/- per share whereby equity share capital has increased by Rs.965.57 lakh and security premium is increased by Rs.5415.99 lakh (Net of Expenses of Rs.132.19 lakh) 5. The company has not carried out restructuring for any of the borrowers’ loan(s) for the quarter & year ended March 31, 2022 under RBI Resolution Framework for Covid-19 Related Stress vide circular no. RBI/2020-21/16 DOR.No.BP.BC/3/21.04.048/2021 dated August 6, 2020. 6. Listed Bonds/NCDs of Rs.15,974 lakh and MLD of Rs.4,000 lakh are secured by first pari-passu charge on the loan assets receivables with security coverage of 1 times and 1.1 times respectively. 7. The company is engaged mainly in financing and investment business activity. Since all activities are related to the main activity there is no separate reportable segment as per the Ind AS 108 on 'Operating Segments'. 8. Figures in financial statements have been rounded off to the nearest lakh (except number of shares) and previous year figures have been re-grouped, re-arranged wherever necessary to make them comparable with figures of the current year. 9.
